aj_definitions.A: lapse = no spud date AND (status EX OR (follow>400 days AND status != AC)); lapse time set to 365 days (nominal expiry). AC wells with no spud date are treated as censored at follow, because AC with no dates likely means missing records, not a lapse.
aj_definitions.B: lapse = no spud date AND (status EX OR follow>400 days), lapse time 365 days. Includes AC with missing dates as lapses (upper bound for lapse).

sens_notes: spud_nofp_failed_after_365d: wells with a spud date, no first production, and >=365 days since spud are treated as known never-producers (KM: never censored, stay in risk set; cure model: contribute log pi). Base case censors them at follow.

meta.notes: All times in days since permit approval. Cure fraction pi = share who never produce.
